purpose: Exploratory aggregate evidence for response-window estimation; not deployed coefficients. See docs/claude-latency-estimation-study.md.

metadata.clock_semantics: Sender event to retained response events; requested_at is first retained response, never verified request-send time; tool spans are call to result observation

regression.method: Same family-balanced ridge/log1p and independent calibration correction as context study. Tool priors trained only on training families; no held-out result timestamps enter start-only features. Retrospective elapsed windows, not verified inference time. All results exploratory.
